name: ci-failure
description: Sort CI failures by cause: code, flaky, infra, dependency, config or other.

code.covers: The change under test is wrong: a failing assertion, compile, type or lint error.
code.not: A test that fails only sometimes.

flaky.covers: A test that fails only sometimes: timing, races, test order, random data.
flaky.not: The CI machine or a network service failing.

infra.covers: The CI machine or a service failed: lost runner, out of disk or memory, network, registry or rate limit errors.
infra.not: A problem in the code or tests.

options.dependency: A new or changed version of a third-party package or tool broke the build.
options.config: The CI configuration, secrets or environment variables are wrong or missing.
options.other: The log fits none of the causes above.
